title: Cloud secret services and integration with the cluster

videos.script: Lesson 9 left a token in Vault and a pod that can prove who it is. Most programs never talk to Vault, though. They read a file, or an environment variable. {{gap}} This lesson installs an operator that does the talking. It logs in to the store, reads the entries you name, and writes ordinary Secrets. {{operator}} Production's token moves from a SOPS file to Vault. Then you change it in Vault, and watch the pod see the new value, with no commit and no restart. {{refresh}} Then the clouds. AWS, Google and Azure each run a secret store, and the operator talks to all three the same way. {{clouds}} The part that matters is how it logs in: with no password at all, through an identity the cloud learned to trust. {{identity}}
